question.en: What most clearly distinguishes RepLKNet from conventional small-kernel CNNs?
question.zh: RepLKNet 与传统小卷积核 CNN 最明显的区别是什么？

options.en: It uses re-parameterized depth-wise kernels as large as 31x31
options.zh: 它使用最大 31×31 的重参数化深度卷积核

options.en: It removes convolution and uses only self-attention
options.zh: 它移除卷积，只使用自注意力

options.en: It is trained only on text tokens
options.zh: 它只使用文本 token 训练

options.en: It requires a separate model for every image class
options.zh: 它要求每个图像类别使用独立模型

explanation.en: RepLKNet is a pure CNN whose large depth-wise kernels reach 31x31 and whose training branches can be structurally re-parameterized for deployment.
explanation.zh: RepLKNet 是纯 CNN，其大核深度卷积最大达到 31×31，训练期分支还可以通过结构重参数化合并用于部署。
